name: extension_adds
description: What a live extension adds: the capability it provides beyond core conformance.

aiGuidance.purpose: The capability this extension provides beyond core conformance, for a live extension.
aiGuidance.extraction: State the capability directly, in continuous prose, no headings. Restate what is already normative elsewhere in the specification for this extension; do not introduce a new claim here. Empty on a dormant record.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not use this field to state new normative rules — it summarises what the extension's own normative surface already establishes.
